description: The one-statement gate counts a text as it is read to run it: two dollars inside a name open no dollar-quoted body, a carriage return ends a line comment, a block's word used as a name opens no block - so a second statement cannot ride in behind any of them - and a semicolon inside a string, a quoted name, a dollar-quoted body or a comment ends no statement.

skip.reason: the engine's own API takes a script whatever MULTI_STATEMENT_COUNT says; the one-statement gate is the driver's and the HTTP endpoint's

steps.sql: SELECT 1 AS a$$b; DELETE FROM sc

error.messageContains: Actual statement count 2 did not match the desired statement count 1
